notes.title: Hotfix: v1.0.2
notes.notes:
[p]A small batch of fixes and improvements were released today.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Achievements now will unlock correctly. If you've already passed an achievement milestone, the game will run an internal check and unlock everything you should have unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]UI buttons are now rendering correctly, no matter the resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Gold to Era Points (prestige) rate decreased.[/p][/*][*][p]Era Points (prestige) to DPS (damage) rate decreased.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We appreciate all your reports. Best regards,[/p][p]Two Pixels [/p]

notes.title: Critical Fix - Game not rendering on certain screen sizes.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627920/87bae50739c33590baf4bd01a180680347af5498.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just released a critical fix that addresses a critical bug that many of you encountered in the release build. Thanks to the community’s help, we were able to resolve the issue without even having the necessary setup to reproduce it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s been fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Game not rendering in widescreen resolutions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We sincerely appreciate your patience and dedication, especially those of you who took the time to collect and share logs, as well as help with various internal tests.[/p][p][/p][p]If you run into any further issues, please let us know.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Special thanks to the user BornesDrunkAgain, who ran several tests and shared crucial information of the game-braking setup.[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes: [p]With the launch fast approaching, we've been playing Timeline Keepers non-stop to find any broken text, bugs, or anything else that might spoil the player's fun.[/p][p][/p][p]Tweeks in the balancing, color improvement, optimization even further and much more. We are officially ready. And this time is for REAL![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Timeline Keepers will launch 05/06/2025 in the afternoon - UTC-3.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627920/2bb92daa13ca97e684bde9181f56ad58c267ca94.png"][/img][/p]
